name: jfx-demo
description: A real consumer of @anjunar/jfx-core + @anjunar/jfx-router + @anjunar/scalajs-jfx-bridge -- Vite dev server, Express SSR, hydration, client-side routing, plus Node runners that render the page bodies against the stub and against the linked Scala.js runtime. The Vite-side counterpart to the repo root's own application/ setup.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify:runtime
